nom: good light Strawberry Moon Grinding Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: good light has made skincare something i look forward to doing. this is my second time having their products and i'm so happy with my purchase.

I went ahead and tried this cleanser. I wear medium to heavy makeup,not everyday probably two to three times a week and the performance was fine. my main ick was the product itself. didn't last as long as I would like and I did have to dip in a second time to completely remove makeup.
The packaging is fun and all, but the product works really well even at removing stubborn mascara. The biggest pro is the smell. It smells DIVINE.

avis.titre: I need a hundred of these
avis.texte: this is phenomenal. I love the packaging design because you dont have to scoop in with ur fingers. it works great, and feels great too. has a nice light scent. feels gentle on the skin.

Smells amazing, feels amazing, makes my face look and feel amazing after use! I purchased this on October 11 and just ran out of it today, November 25 after using 2-3 "turns" daily. I use it as the first step in my cleansing routine and then follow with a foaming cleanser. I am hooked!

avis.titre: Good product, not enough of it
avis.texte: I was recommended this by an Ulta associate. It works great to remove my makeup and as a cleanser. My face was left feeling very soft. Unfortunately, after less than a month I ran out of product. For the price, I cant justify buying this again.

avis.titre: The best cleansing balm I've ever tried
avis.texte: The package is sanitary, no contamination to the remaining product. Very lightweight and easily emulsifies with water. Rinses off well and leaves ZERO residue. My skin feels so so soft after and my blackheads are basically non-existent. 10/10, highly recommend 🤩
Its a slay! The clean ingredients and strawberry milk cleanse — with a fragrance so good and juicy. Love this

avis.titre: Someone said dreamy and this is DREAMY
avis.texte: AHHH Strawberry Moon, how much can I write about thee? This is THE cleansing balm of my dreams. Someone else wrote that and I literally cannot express how much I'm enjoying this. It is creamy, and also the texture is so soft, and I love how the fragrance is strawberry milk. It gets rid of ALL my makeup. And softens skin with a oh-so-great feel. Thank you
I love this so much! The smell, the texture, and especially the dispenser. It makes me want to wash my face, when normally I'm so lazy about it.
Smells great and neat packaging, but broke me out with painful cystic acne every single time i used it and will be returning.

I didn't expect anything less from good light. This is the oil cleanse I've been waiting for. The softest and most beautiful cleansing experience that turns into strawberry milk – nourishes without stripping. OBSESSED with this. The fragrance is also pleasant and I love.
